findings.summary: Segment redemption rate SQL always produces 100 for any non-empty group
findings.details: Original SQL: ROUND(SUM(total_redeemed_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_redeemed_count), 0), 2) — numerator and denominator are the same column, so every non-empty group returns 100.0. Rate becomes 1.0000 after /100 in row mapper.
findings.recommendation: Use weighted average of MV's pre-computed redemption_rate column: SUM(total_redeemed_count * redemption_rate) / NULLIF(SUM(total_redeemed_count), 0)

findings.summary: Missing @JsonInclude(ALWAYS) on SegmentRedemptionDto — null region/role omitted from JSON
findings.details: Global JacksonConfig sets NON_NULL. Without @JsonInclude(ALWAYS) on the DTO, null region and null role are stripped from the JSON response. The FE needs stable field presence to render '—' for null cells (AC-4).

findings.summary: Per-row BigDecimal.valueOf(100) allocation in row mapper lambda
findings.details: Row mapper lambda called BigDecimal.valueOf(100) on every row, allocating a new object each time.
findings.recommendation: Extract private static final BigDecimal ONE_HUNDRED = BigDecimal.valueOf(100)

findings.summary: replaceAll("[\r\n]", "_") compiles the regex on every log call
findings.details: Multiple String.replaceAll calls compiled the regex per invocation instead of reusing a pre-compiled Pattern.
findings.recommendation: Add private static final Pattern CRLF_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("[\r\n]") and use CRLF_PATTERN.matcher(value).replaceAll("_")

findings.details: RoundingMode was used fully-qualified rather than via an import statement.

findings.summary: Contract drift — role query param missing from OpenAPI spec
findings.details: The contract YAML does not include role as a query parameter (predates spec update). The implementation correctly adds role per FR-08.2 override.
findings.recommendation: Update contract YAML to add role as an optional query parameter ($RC_MANUAL — outside this diff scope)

findings.summary: Contract drift — partnerTier field still in SegmentRedemptionDto schema
findings.details: The contract YAML still references partnerTier in SegmentRedemptionDto but spec FR-08.2 explicitly dropped it. Implementation correctly omits tier.
findings.recommendation: Update contract YAML to remove partnerTier and align field names ($RC_MANUAL — outside this diff scope)

advisoryFindings.tierReason: Pre-existing MV design issue — total_redeemed_count semantics inherited from DDL, not introduced by this PR. Field name in spec (redeemedCount) has no 'completed only' qualifier in AC-3.
advisoryFindings.summary: redeemedCount includes failed/cancelled requests, not just COMPLETED
advisoryFindings.details: MV total_redeemed_count = COUNT(*) over all non-deleted requests; contract description says 'Total number of completed redemptions for this segment'. Semantic gap exists at MV level. Implementation faithfully projects the MV column.
advisoryFindings.recommendation: Track in data model tech debt: consider adding completed_count column to MV or renaming totalRedeemedCount → totalSubmittedCount in contract. Out of scope for this story.

advisoryFindings.tierReason: Contract drift was already flagged in security-review ($RC_MANUAL). Spec explicitly overrides contract (tier dropped, role added, field renamed). Not a defect introduced by this PR.
advisoryFindings.summary: Response shape diverges from checked-in OpenAPI contract — partnerTier, totalRedeemedCount, totalRedeemedAmount, redemptionRate as 0-100
advisoryFindings.details: Contract YAML schema has partnerTier, totalRedeemedCount, totalRedeemedAmount, redemptionRate as 0-100 percentage. Implementation follows updated spec: region, role, currencyId, redeemedCount, redemptionRate as 0.0-1.0 decimal (AC-3). Contract needs additive update.
advisoryFindings.recommendation: Update contracts/endpoints/redemption-advanced-analytics.yaml SegmentRedemptionDto schema to match implementation. $RC_MANUAL item already logged.
